name: Three-wire inductive proximity switch
summary: A three-wire inductive proximity switch uses separate supply, common and output conductors.
description: A three-wire inductive proximity switch uses separate supply, common and output conductors. Its output polarity and load connection must match the receiving input module.
readingNotes: Follow the output common and receiving input polarity together.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
drawingChecklist: State PNP or NPN as specified
distinction: Three-wire construction describes wiring; NO or NC describes the output's documented switching behaviour.
